intro: Sign in with your phone number to continue your process.
phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +52.
verifyIntro: Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone.
pickIntro: This phone has several workers. Choose your name to see only your information.
sessionReady: Your identity is selected. Your information and actions are stored separately from other workers.
logoutHint: Your pending actions are kept when you sign out.
unavailable: The application is not available right now.
runtimeError: Storage could not be opened. Close and reopen the application.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number with its country code.
errors.invalid_otp: Check the six-digit code and try again.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.secure_storage: Your session could not be securely saved or removed. Try again before continuing.
errors.worker_forbidden: This identity is not available. Sign in again.
errors.reauthenticate: Your session expired. Sign in again; your pending actions are kept.
errors.invalid_response: The response could not be verified. Try again.
errors.request_unavailable: Wait for the operation to finish and try again.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
errors.sync_unavailable: Your saved actions are kept. Synchronization is unavailable; try again when connected.

configurationError: The service connection is not configured. Contact the support team.
